The primary objective of the Committee shall be to
improve the remittance system for the Filipino overseas workers through the
official exchange channels.
This Committee shall have the following functions:
to adopt ,policies and programs which shall attract increased
remittance of the earnings of Filipino overseas workers anq tap
the vast potentials of the said foreign exchange source;
to approve and confirm the adoption of a package of incentives
to Filipino overseas workers to encourage them to remit their
earnings through official channels;
